tools.description:

        readiness, and web accessibility. Use this when someone asks what TESSA

        Optional filters:
            category_slug: marketing | web-development | ai-experiences | accessibility

tools.title: TESSA accessibility audit offer

tools.description:
Quick automated check of how ready a website is for AI assistants and
        agents: 12 of the 46 items in TESSA's AI Readiness audit, checked on the
        homepage and a few standard files in about 15 seconds. Not the full audit.

        Items (by audit number): 4 robots.txt allows AI crawlers, 5 the firewall
        serves the homepage to real AI crawler user agents (OAI-SearchBot,
        PerplexityBot, Claude-User) the same as to a browser, 6 content readable
        without JavaScript, 7 XML sitemap, 8 llms.txt, 9 /pricing.md,
        10 Organization or LocalBusiness schema, 16 one H1, 18 phone, address and
        hours as plain text, 32 schema potentialAction, 41 A2A agent card,
        43 MCP server card.

        Returns each item's status (pass, partial, fail or could_not_check) with
        evidence and a plain-English fix, a 0 to 100 overall_score over the items
        that could be checked (could_not_check never counts as a fail), what the
        full audit adds, and TESSA's contact details. The full audit covers all 46
        items across the site plus a live ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Gemini
        citation test; book it with request_strategy_session.

        url: the website to check, for example https://example.com
tools.name: assess_ai_readiness
tools.title: Quick AI readiness check of a website

tools.description:
Free quick SEO check of any website's homepage: indexability (noindex,
        robots.txt, sitemap), title and meta description, one clear H1,
        canonical, mobile setup and speed; 0 to 100 score, what passes and
        fails, how to fix each. Automated, homepage only, not a full SEO audit.

        12 items, about 12 seconds. Each item has a status (pass, partial, fail
        or could_not_check), evidence and a plain-English fix; the score covers
        only the items that could be checked. For TESSA's SEO service call
        get_seo_offer; to talk it through, book with request_strategy_session.

        url: the website to check, for example https://example.com
tools.name: assess_seo
tools.title: Quick SEO check of a website

tools.description:
Free quick ad tracking check of any website's homepage: GA4, Google Tag
        Manager, Google Ads, Meta Pixel, Microsoft and LinkedIn tags, call
        tracking, consent, phone link, form or call to action, and speed; 0 to
        100 score, what passes and fails, how to fix each. Tags inside Google
        Tag Manager are looked up in its published container; if it cannot be
        read they are reported as could not check, never as missing.
        Automated, homepage only, not a full ad account audit.

        11 items, about 12 seconds. Each item has a status (pass, partial, fail
        or could_not_check), evidence and a plain-English fix; the score covers
        only the items that could be checked. For TESSA's advertising service
        call get_advertising_offer; to talk it through, book with
        request_strategy_session.

        url: the website to check, for example https://example.com
tools.name: assess_ad_tracking
tools.title: Quick ad tracking check of a website

tools.description:
Free quick website check of any website's homepage: HTTPS, mobile
        setup, load time and page weight, platform, security headers, basic
        accessibility signals, contact form or chat, and an up-to-date footer;
        0 to 100 score, what passes and fails, how to fix each. Automated,
        homepage only, not a full website audit.

        12 items (the platform is reported, not scored), about 12 seconds. Each
        item has a status (pass, partial, fail or could_not_check), evidence and
        a plain-English fix; the score covers only the items that could be
        checked. For TESSA's website and AI development service call
        get_web_ai_development_offer, for a full accessibility audit
        get_wcag_audit; to talk it through, book with request_strategy_session.

        url: the website to check, for example https://example.com
tools.name: assess_website
tools.title: Quick website check

tools.description:
Book a free 30-minute strategy session with TESSA (with Kevin Callen,
        President). Finds an open slot, creates a Google Meet invite and emails
        it to the prospect. Only call this when the user has asked to book a
        call and has given their real email address.

        prospect_email:   the user's email (required; temporary inboxes are refused)
        prospect_name:    the user's name
        prospect_org:     the user's company
        project_brief:    what they want help with
        requested_window: when they are free, for example '2026-10-06',
                          '2026-10-06T13:00/2026-10-06T17:00', 'tomorrow' or 'next week'

        Up to 10 bookings per email per 7 days; past that it returns status 'duplicate'.
tools.name: request_strategy_session
tools.title: Book a strategy session with TESSA

tools.description:
Send a message to TESSA's sales team, the same as the contact form on
        tessa.tech. TESSA replies by email within one business day. Use this when
        the user wants TESSA to contact them but does not want to book a call.
        Only call it when the user has asked to and has given their real email.

        prospect_email:   the user's email (required; temporary inboxes are refused)
        prospect_name:    the user's name
        prospect_org:     the user's company
        project_brief:    the message
        requested_window: optional, when they would like to hear back
tools.name: contact_tessa
tools.title: Send TESSA a message
